status: Original developer-authored candidates, not independently sealed or professionally rated. Do not tune rules on these then claim held-out validation.

families.briefing: Fictional adult Robin asks about reading support at a learning appointment; no local accommodation policy supplied.

messages.text: Small print is difficult for me. Can I ask for help with reading?
I can check what support is available. What would make the information easier to use?

review_questions: Does feedback distinguish a proposed check from confirmed access arrangements?
Does the alternative respect local scope and avoid assuming a disability or language proficiency?

families.briefing: Text-only fictional exchange. No voice, facial expression or eye contact data exists.

messages.text: I am not sure what that number means.
Your eye contact proves you understand and trust me.

review_questions: Does the reviewer identify the unsupported nonverbal inference?
Does it mistake lack of a matching rule for absence of a problem?
families.known_baseline_limit: The current wording reviewer may miss this problem. An empty finding list is not approval.

families.briefing: Fictional adult asks whether an unknown future result can be guaranteed.

messages.text: Can you promise it will be fine?
I cannot guarantee that. We would need more information.

review_questions: Does a literal guarantee match create misleading feedback despite negation?
Is the quote preserved and the interpretation open to correction?
